name: DCI SYD02 (Eastern Creek Data Centre Expansion; 'SYD03' in 2023 assessment report)

address.value: 90 Peter Brock Drive, Eastern Creek NSW
address.note: SSD site address; datacentermap lists '1 Raceway Pl' (source 7)

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 90 PETER BROCK DRIVE EASTERN CREEK. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: Stage 3a CEMP (rev 04, 7 Jul 2026): 'for stage 3b - consisting of construction of the SYD02 data centre building ... Multiplex has been contracted as the builder for this stage of the works'. Multiplex also did the earlier SYD02 enabling works (dci-syd02 source 4)

developer.note: SSD applicant NineZero DC Sub TC I Pty Ltd (source 1); NineZero DC entities are DCI/Brookfield (source 5)

mw_it.note: planning documents state power consumption only (see mw_grid); no IT figure. Listings' ~36 MW relates to the superseded 2020 Council-approved SYD02 design

mw_grid.note: power consumption of the expansion: 32 MW as approved 1 Sep 2023 (AR, source 10: existing 7.2 MW + 32 MW = 39.2 MW site total), increased to 63 MW by Mod 2 (determined 5 Aug 2026) via 'greater rack densities within the approved SYD02 building'; portal describes Mod 2 as overall power consumption 70.2 MW (site total incl. SYD01)

cost_aud_m.note: capital investment value $330,311,108 in Assessment Report (Sept 2023); 'direct investment of more than $330 million'. Mod 2 CIV change not found

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning and Environment (now DPHI)
authority.note: Blacktown LGA; determined by Director under delegation

reference.note: Mod 1 (water storage and parking) approved 18 Sep 2025; Mod 2 (power 32 to 63 MW, lodged 23 Jan 2026) determined 5 Aug 2026. Applicant NineZero DC Sub TC I Pty Ltd

lodged.note: EIS appendices uploaded to the portal 28 Jun 2022 (lodgement date not stated in AR; AR notes the 2022 Approved Methods came into force 'just prior to the SSD application being lodged'). Exhibited 11 Oct - 7 Nov 2022

jobs_construction.note: AR: 'provide up to 150 construction jobs'; basis not defined

jobs_operational.note: Mod 2 AR table: 'Operational staff 100 -> 70' after removal of the approved 4-storey office building

jobs_operational_other.note: original AR: '76 additional operational jobs' (also 'up to 76 additional knowledge-intensive operational jobs')
original AR (evaluation section): 'up to 150 construction jobs and 100 operational jobs'; Mod 2 AR gives 100 as the approved staff figure

construction_start.note: DCI notice (13 Jun 2025): construction commencing 30 June 2025 with Stage 1 enabling works (demolition); Stage 2 tanks from 13 Oct 2025; Stage 3 main works (civil, substation, then SYD02 building) notified to commence 22 Jun 2026 (source 14)

construction_end.note: AR: construction 'expected to take up to 24 months to complete'; no completion date published

open_questions: merged: former row dci-syd02 folded into this record (decision 2026-09-27). The 2020 Council-approved SYD02 design (SPP-19-00009, 36 MW, A$400m announced) was never commenced and DCI committed to relinquish it; DCI now uses the name 'SYD02' for this SSD-21342738 building. Whether SPP-19-00009 was formally surrendered is unconfirmed
no IT MW stated; mw_grid 63 MW is power consumption after Mod 2
completion date unknown; Multiplex confirmed as builder for Stage 3b (building)
